subject: QBR: Infra runway snapshot & OKR readout — GPU unit economics / batching impact
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR prep — runway snapshot + OKR readout (ask list)

Team,

We have the leadership QBR next Thursday and I want a concise infra-runway section focused on (a) GPU spend vs runway, (b) utilization trends, and (c) concrete batching / caching levers that materially change unit economics. Please assemble short slides + a one-page annex per item below. Keep it executive-friendly — 6-8 bullets max.

Ask list (deliver by EOD Wed):
- Rishi: updated GPU spend forecast for 6/12/24 and 3/6/12 month runways, with sensitivity to spot vs reserved.
- Vivek: current fleet utilization heatmap (p95, p50) and short list of two immediate ops knobs (autoscale changes, reserve pools).
- Lauren: OKR readout—what we committed vs on-track — highlight risks if runway tightens by 20%.
- Irene: one-paragraph note on batching + prefix caching experiments (quantify token savings where possible).

Attach anything you want me to lodge into the QBR doc in Drive and flag any asks that require exec approval (credits, SLA exception, commit).

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Platform Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep — runway snapshot + OKR readout (ask list)

Naomi — sending the first pass. Attachment contains a 6/3/1 quarter runway sensitivity and a short commentary. Key bullets here:

- Baseline monthly GPU spend run-rate: $1.45M. With current commitments (including dedicated pools) runway to 0 reserve = ~10 months.
- If spot capacity drops 30% we see immediate 18% increase in per-token cost; runway shrinks to ~8.2 months.
- Batching: enabling continuous batching for mid-sized requests reduces token compute by ~14% in our tests (latency p50 up by ~30ms). Strongest gains for seq-lengths 64-512.
- KV/prefix cache: for chat-heavy workloads we measured 12% token cost reduction; for stateless text gen this is ~4%.
- Asks: need approval to convert 40% of burst budget to reserved for Q4 (expected to lower unit-cost by 6-8% overall).

Attachment: runway_sensitivity_v2.xlsx (sheets: summary, scenarios, assumptions)

Thumbs up — attached a short OKR readout and two risk scenarios. Highlights:

- OKR status: Serving reliability (KR1) 72% -> off-track target (need +1 eng sprint to finish observability), Cost/unit (KR2) forecast improving but sensitive to spot volatility.
- If runway shrinks 20% we should re-prioritize the non-customer-facing infra work (2-week deferral).
- Request: please include a 1-line ask for the ELT to approve re-allocating $200k from marketing Q4 to reserved GPU commits if consensus on savings.

Attachment: okr-readout-draft.md

Adding ops signal context and two quick levers:

- Utilization: weekly heatmap attached. P50=58%, P95=92% busy. Main bottleneck late-afternoon US west region due to sync jobs.
- Ops levers we can flip in <48h: (1) tighten autoscale cooldowns for non-latency routes (+3-4% immediate utilization), (2) enable a small reserved pool for 3rd-party demo traffic (reduces noise on p95).
- Note on risk: any aggressive batching increase impacts p99 on interactive routes — need to pair with per-route fallback.

Attachment: batching_cache_impact.pdf

Thanks for the transparency — Acme is sensitive to latency and we like the idea of per-route batching controls. A couple quick items from our side:

- Is there a recommended fallback model if spot capacity is reduced? We saw a small increase in failure-rate last month during a spot supply dip.
- Can you share the expected p50/p95 latency delta if continuous batching is fully enabled for our demo traffic?

Happy to hop on a 20-min sync if that helps.

—Jessica

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-infra-prep

If there are any exec asks that require a decision during the QBR, flag them clearly in the top slide. I want us to present a clear ask + impact number.

Thanks — Naomi
